dataset.judgment_method: Deterministic weak labels from declared category specification predicates. These are not human relevance judgments and are not eligible for production or resume metric claims.
dataset.name: buildcores-real-catalog-retrieval-silver-pilot

learning_to_rank_status.reason: Training LambdaMART on labels generated from these same predicates would measure label reconstruction and leak the evaluation target.

limitations: Relevance grades are deterministic silver labels derived from the same declared specification predicates used to define each query; no human relevance review was done.
Queries cover declared catalog fields, not subjective workload value or compatibility.
Catalog specifications are community-maintained and may contain missing or stale fields.
No prices, availability, observed user behavior, or reviewer agreement are evaluated.
Some broad queries have more silver-relevant products than a retrieval cutoff, so the artifact records the query-level macro Recall@K ceiling.
Heuristic and LambdaMART rankers are omitted because required independent price, performance, preference, and human-label evidence is not present in this pilot.

bm25.basis: rank_bm25 over the same labelled product text as the embedding index

rrf_hybrid.basis: reciprocal rank fusion of complete BM25 and vector rankings

stable_product_id_negative_control.basis: ascending product ID; diagnostic negative control

vector_only.basis: cosine similarity against the existing frozen embedding matrix
